completion_definition: independent oracle correct, all required inputs read, report verified, per-node audits committed before following the next node or writing the final chain, no repeated committed writes, and original Work durably completed
stop_policy: runtime pause/failure, or 10 consecutive activations with no new successful read/write path, semantic context note or same original code snapshot advancing across activations; no task time ceiling

        key = rid

print(r.get("data"))

print(s.get("status"), s.get("ok"), repr(s.get("data")))
n = await yuki_workspace_list({"path": "/workspace/nodes", "limit": 100})
print(n.get("status"), n.get("ok"))
print(n.get("data"))

import asyncio

names = ['1a8cce3d','34aaa432','41229f1b','44d1a529','5b2f8b98','664d7819','71403a74','745f1a9b','855581af','8b234427','8bb98bbd','94d0a5a9','ae18c2af','b1aa6f4e','c35375a9','d4f83836','eb12994f','f0eaea04']
paths = ["/workspace/nodes/%s.txt" % n for n in names]

async def rd(p):
    return p, await yuki_workspace_read({"path": p})

res = []
for i in range(0, len(paths), 9):
    res.extend(await asyncio.gather(*[rd(p) for p in paths[i:i+9]]))

nodes = {}
for p, r in res:
    assert r.get("ok"), (p, r.get("status"))
    d = {}
    for line in r["data"]["text"].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if "=" in line:
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            d[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    nodes[p] = d

cur = "nodes/34aaa432.txt"  # from start.txt
chain = []
seen = set()
while True:
    if cur == "END":
        break
    assert cur not in seen, "loop at %s" % cur
    seen.add(cur)
    full = "/workspace/" + cur
    assert full in nodes, full
    nd = nodes[full]
    v = int(nd["value"])
    chain.append((cur, v))
    nxt = nd["left"] if v % 2 == 0 else nd["right"]
    print(cur, "value=%d" % v, "even->left" if v % 2 == 0 else "odd->right", "->", nxt)
    cur = nxt

total = sum(v for _, v in chain)
lines = ["%s\t%d" % (p, v) for p, v in chain] + ["TOTAL\t%d" % total]
content = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
print("LEN", len(chain), "TOTAL", total)
print(content)
w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "/workspace/chain.tsv", "text": content})
print("WRITE", w.get("status"), w.get("ok"), w.get("data"))

import asyncio

async def read(p):
    r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/" + p})
    return r

async def main():
    start = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/start.txt"})
    lines = []
    cur = start["data"]["text"].strip()
    total = 0
    guard = 0
    while guard < 100:
        guard += 1
        r = await read(cur)
        if not r["ok"]:
            return {"error": "read failed", "path": cur, "receipt": r}
        fields = {}
        for ln in r["data"]["text"].splitlines():
            if "=" in ln:
                k, v = ln.split("=", 1)
                fields[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        val = int(fields["value"])
        lines.append(cur + "\t" + str(val))
        total += val
        nxt = fields["left"] if val % 2 == 0 else fields["right"]
        if nxt.upper() == "END":
            break
        cur = nxt
    return {"lines": lines, "total": total, "steps": len(lines), "guard": guard}

res = await main()
res
